root_cause: MO14 planner source was added to the business-system repository without its exact delivery-lane ownership, metadata and required one-loop learning artifacts; the independent Netlify site still requires its own authorized deploy and provider readback.
fix: Register only pw-mo14-1/zaalplanner/ under the canonical website delivery lane, add pure regression and full machine/ledger/human learning records to the same PR, retain GitHub branch protection, and publish the existing MO14 Netlify project using direct GitHub/Netlify authority only (never Make).
prevention_rules: Register new separately hosted UI source paths in the canonical delivery planner and assert exact ownership before first PR CI.
Require real PR Obligation-ID, Delivery-Lane, Candidate-Type and immutable Base-SHA before PR admission.
Keep the original MO14 static site unchanged unless the deploy includes its existing files and the new planner.
Do not weaken protected GitHub checks or use Make for MO14 production releases.
Only mark LIVE_PROVEN after a new provider deploy ID, correct site ID, successful HTTP readback of /zaalplanner/ and functional keeper/absent/export verification.
MO14 Netlify credentials are short-lived; check actual provider authorization and refuse a 401 rather than marking LIVE, and never use Make.
A standalone mobile PWA must ship manifest, scoped service worker, icons and cached application shell with actual route readback.
Rotate 5 field slots by exactly 5 cyclic places between blocks to guarantee maximum simultaneous field changes with N available field players.
With N=9, 4 players leave and enter at each of 3 boundaries across 4×10-minute blocks; show the one player staying and the keeper.
Render each matchday full width on phones with cards stacked, independently verify no horizontal overflow at 320–820 px.
Fail closed on incomplete runtime rotation tests or expiring Netlify credentials; never claim READY without provider deploy ID and browser/HTTP readback.
Separate forecast versus confirmed actual minutes, validate both field and goalie totals (5× and 1× game length) before committing.
Incorporate confirmed game minutes into subsequent game optimization and never infer real play from an unexecuted rotation plan.
Validate portable JSON backups before any overwrite; reject malformed or oversized files, require explicit user confirmation.
Test release failure modes: unresolved JS identifiers and expired scoped provider tokens must fail closed before marking production green.
Treat all pages on a shared origin as one security boundary; enforce CSP on legacy root as well as modern PWA routes.
Never rely on CSP to revoke a historical public webhook endpoint; provider-level revocation is required.
Record provider deploy and independent HTTP header/functionality readback; no partial success from GitHub source tests alone.
owner: original MO14-1 website protected delivery lane
terminal_rule: Isolated MO14 V9 Netlify production LIVE_PROVEN after provider CURRENT/READY and browser actual-minute and backup acceptance. Do not assert total-time parity including a permanent keeper or that parent repo protected merge #5875 is complete.
